name: aromir_benzene_cb01c7c
purpose: TASKS 245, 73 (16 Nov 2026): the first full `aromir spectrum` on a real molecule with the pipeline as rebuilt today (aromir cb01c7c: every step saved as one file, soft modes always measured, the licence read on the band error, the record's format 2) — none had run end to end; the session that built it could not finish furan inside its ten-minute limit. Benzene with the release inside the package, to be read against the certificate of 15 Nov (aromir 58d2065, probes/results_m1/aromir_benzene_v13_2026-11-15): positions equal to what the engine's noise allows, the licence now on all four families with the caveat. In WSL from the editable dev environment ~/aromir_dev (the code of ~/aromir-src at cb01c7c; pyscf 2.15.0), capped by probes/wsl_capped.sh beside the live training.
command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -e bash -c "export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONUTF8=1 PYSCF_TMPDIR=/home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp TMPDIR=/home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp; mkdir -p /home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp; cd /mnt/c/Users/thebr/Documents/CapstonePlan/plans/05_delta-probed-ir-pipeline && echo '=== (AROMIR) start' && bash probes/wsl_capped.sh 4096 -- /usr/bin/time -f '(AROMIR) max RSS %M kB, wall %e s' /home/thebreadishard/aromir_dev/bin/aromir spectrum c1ccccc1 --out probes/results_m1/aromir_benzene_cb01c7c_2026-11-16 --threads 8 --max-memory-mb 2048 && echo '=== (AROMIR) done: benzene'"

estimate.basis: benzene on 15 Nov with aromir 58d2065 in WSL on 8 threads beside a training (aromir_benzene_v13): about 25 minutes; the soft-mode measurement adds nothing for a molecule without a mode below 20 cm-1

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run at 4096 MB (pyscf max_memory 2048); benzene at B3LYP/6-31G* is 102 basis functions
